run-the-pair.text: From a clean checkout, run the recorder with the current commit and a temporary output directory. It builds the blueprint once, runs the CI command on the fixed-fallback mutant, which should fail, then on the candidate, which should pass.

read-the-result.text: The mutant record shows a nonzero exit with its four witnesses, and the restored record shows exit zero with the success line and the book. Each log digest matches its record.

check-the-retained-pair.text: The committed records and compressed logs come from one run against the candidate they name. Decompress a log and compare its digest with the record.
